title: meet-ai config
description: Settings for meet-ai, stored in ~/Meetings/.app/config.jsonc. Every key is optional; a missing key uses its default. Unknown keys are allowed and kept.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, so editors can autocomplete and check the file.

app.description: How meet-ai behaves as an app. Closing the main window hides it; meet-ai keeps running in the menu bar until you quit it.

show_in_dock_when_closed.description: macOS: keep the Dock icon while the main window is closed. false = only the menu-bar item stays, like Granola.

menu_bar_countdown.description: macOS: show the next meeting next to the menu-bar icon, like "Weekly sync in 12m", from an hour before it starts. Off by default.

transcription.description: How speech is turned into text.

engine.description: Which speech-to-text engine to use. "auto" picks the best one for this Mac. Forcing an engine this Mac cannot run is an error, not a silent fallback.

model.description: Whisper model name, used when the whisper engine runs.

language.description: Spoken language of the meeting, as a language code. Not read by the app yet (SPEC Phase 6); setting it has no effect for now.

live.description: Transcribe while the call is running. false = transcribe only after recording stops. Not read by the app yet (SPEC Phase 6); setting it has no effect for now.

retention_days.description: Days to keep a meeting's audio (audio/*.wav) after it ends; the transcript, notes and tasks are always kept. 0 = delete the audio as soon as the transcript is done, -1 = keep it forever. Checked on launch and once a day.

warn_no_headphones.description: Warn when recording without headphones, since speakers can echo into the mic. Not read by the app yet (SPEC Phase 6); setting it has no effect for now.

use_builtin_mic_with_bluetooth.description: When the Mac's input is Bluetooth headphones, record the Mac's own mic instead, so the headphones keep their full sound. Opening a Bluetooth mic switches the headphones to call mode, which is quieter. false = record the Bluetooth mic. macOS only; needs a Mac with a built-in mic.

calendar.description: Where upcoming meetings are read from.

providers.$comment: TUR-49: the default is ["eventkit"] on macOS and [] on Windows and Linux, which have no Calendar app; "eventkit" there is an error.
providers.description: Calendar sources to read. "eventkit" is the macOS Calendar app.

ics_urls.description: Unused: ignored; ICS was dropped on 2026-10-03 (SPEC A12). Still accepted so old configs load.

refresh_minutes.description: How often, in minutes, to re-read the calendars.

google.description: The Google OAuth client used by "Sign in with Google". Create one of type Desktop app (SETUP.md, Calendar sign-in).

client_secret.description: The client secret Google gives a Desktop app client. Google treats it as non-secret (it ships inside every desktop app), but it must be sent with each token request. Sign-in itself is protected by PKCE.

microsoft.description: The Microsoft app registration used by "Sign in with Microsoft": a public client with an http://127.0.0.1 redirect (SETUP.md, Calendar sign-in). No client secret.

client_id.description: The Application (client) ID from the app registration.

hooks.description: Your own commands, run at three moments of a meeting. Each runs in the system shell (sh on macOS and Linux, cmd on Windows, PowerShell for a .ps1 file) with the meeting folder in MEETAI_MEETING_DIR and as the last argument. A failing hook is logged and never stops the meeting.

on_analysis_complete.description: Runs once the agent has written the meeting notes.

timeout_secs.description: Seconds a hook may run before it and everything it started are stopped.

detection.description: Signals used to notice that a meeting has started.

calendar.description: Use calendar events to spot meetings.

processes.description: Watch for running meeting apps, such as Zoom or Teams.

audio_activity.description: Watch for the mic and speakers being used at the same time.

min_attendees.description: Only treat a calendar event as a meeting if it has at least this many attendees.

remind_before_minutes.description: How many minutes before a meeting starts its reminder fires. 0 = at the start. A value outside 0-15 is logged and read as 1.

agent.description: The agent CLI the app runs to write notes and tasks when a call ends.

harness.description: Which agent CLI to run. "none" = copy-prompt fallback: the prompt is put on the clipboard for you to paste into an agent yourself.

model.description: Model to use. Any model name the chosen CLI accepts. null = no --model flag, so the CLI uses its own default (for Claude Code, the model in its own settings).

binary_path.description: Full path to the agent CLI. Set this when auto-detect cannot find it; null = find it automatically.

auto_run.description: Start writing notes on their own when a call ends.

timeout_sec.description: Longest time, in seconds, one agent run may take before it is stopped.

tickets.description: Where tasks are synced to. The agent does the syncing through its own connections.

tracker.description: Issue tracker that tasks are synced to.

tracker_mcp.description: Name of the tracker's MCP server, exactly as the chosen CLI lists it. It is named in the Sync prompt; the app never calls it itself.

repos.description: Code repositories that tasks relate to. Not read by the app yet (SPEC Phase 6); setting it has no effect for now.

default.description: Repository folder used for Start Work when a task names no other. A leading ~ means your home folder.
